scope: Lossy notation projection; equality does not establish text, glyph or locus identity

rules.historical_selection: native transcriber H, including padding-only envelopes
rules.modern_selection: IT2a present loci; nonexistent loci excluded
rules.comments: historical balanced curly comments; modern IVTFF free comments
rules.projection: retain only lowercase ASCII a-z, concatenate in native source order per exact page ID
rules.losses: record boundaries, spaces, word breaks, unknown/rare signs, case and other notation
rules.inference_limit: Neither equal streams nor equal frequencies authorize a crosswalk or full text equality

declared_envelope_diagnostics.status: declared-envelope diagnostic, not manuscript content inclusion
